revision_policy: Includes up to three rounds of visual revisions on the selected direction.

milestones.condition: Due before release of raw files

risk_rules.recommended_fix: Incorporate structured visual feedback templates to keep reviews objective.
Specify that naming is not legally vetted and trademark check is client responsibility.
Tie source file release to final payment and list exactly which files transfer.
Define the number of included concepts and price additional directions separately.

client_responsibilities: Provide clear feedback during creative reviews
timeline_assumptions: Feedback is gathered from all stakeholders and submitted as a unified list.
Concept reviews occur within 3 working days of delivery.
acceptance_criteria: Brand guide style book is finalized.
Logo vector and rasters are exported and shared.
Client signs off on brand rules.

revision: Revisions are confined to refinements of the selected design direction. Pivot changes require a formal scope adjustment.
payment: All master branding source files are released only after all project balances are fully settled.
out_of_scope: Additional visual asset requests will be scoped separately at a standard rate of $150/hr.
client_responsibilities: Client maintains responsibility for visual and legal clearance of corporate naming before asset creation.
ip_ownership: Intellectual property rights for the finalized logo transfer to the client upon final milestone payment clearance.
change_request: Changes to primary layout requirements after layout sign-off require a formal design change order fee.
Any request that changes approved deliverables, timing, assumptions, or acceptance criteria requires written approval before work begins.
timeline: Timeline delays resulting from client review latency will push subsequent deliverable checkpoints.
Milestones depend on timely client feedback, access, content, approvals, and third-party provider availability.

hidden_scope_traps: New logo directions requested after direction approval
Trademark or naming validation assumed to be included
Packaging, social, or campaign assets added after brand guide approval
Source file ownership requested before final payment
